title: Enhancing Antimicrobial Susceptibility Testing for Acinetobacter baumannii
author: Sakyi Opoku, Mishra, et al.
materials: Cryogenic stocks of Acinetobacter baumannii isolate(s) of interest
McFarland Standard Kit (ThermoFisher, cat. no. R20241)
Roswell Park Memorial Institute medium (RPMI 1640; Gibco, cat. no. 11875119)
Mueller Hinton II Broth (MHB; BD, cat. no. 212322)

steps.title: Perform MIC testing
steps.instruction: On Day 2, carry out broth microdilution (BMD) minimum‑inhibitory‑concentration (MIC) testing for Acinetobacter baumannii using both RPMI and Mueller‑Hinton broth (MHB) media, and consult the CLSI guidelines (Lewis et al., 2025) for MIC breakpoints, quality‑control strains, and related procedures.

substeps.instruction: Set up BMD assay in RPMI medium.
Set up BMD assay in MHB medium.
Refer to CLSI guidelines for appropriate MIC breakpoints and inclusion of quality‑control strains.
